sentence_text: New developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) could enable competitors to offer new products or services never before seen in the marketplace. While we strive to provide the most cutting-edge technology to our customers, breakthroughs or significant innovations made using AI (or discoveries uncovered through the use of AI) could change the nature of our business. Competitors who advance in this space may be able to offer superior products and services and may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
